The probes load those genuine pinned definitions as inline fixtures and explicitly inject source acceptance for the fixture, while unit tests cover the production pinned-source check.
- Pi has no public workflow completion event and its outbox cannot flush while the current tool batch blocks. A workflow call therefore makes blocking wait unavailable for the rest of the session, even if its attempt was denied. Timeout defaults to 30000 ms with cache=unknown; no effective request TTL is available to the extension, and no cache hit or refresh is claimed.
- Wait and aliases require verified enabled Pi config, including a user-level off overriding a project on; unknown config fails closed. A later disabled state deactivates and denies previously registered wrappers, but Pi has no public unregister API and registry metadata may remain. Original external tools remain unchanged.
